description:
Hi everyone! I'm Shalini Ade, a B.Tech student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIML) at SIRT, Bhopal.

I'm passionate about building innovative, technology-driven solutions to real-world problems. I enjoy exploring AI/ML, Python programming, problem-solving, web development, automation, and emerging technologies.
I've worked on projects involving AI-powered platforms, misinformation detection  student performance prediction, and gesture-controlled robotics.
